title: SpatialContextFrame
description: Schema for Spatial Context Frame connecting Generation Layer (MISO) and Runtime Layer (MIMO)

frame_id.description: Unique identifier for the frame (e.g. frame_0001, view_front)

image_path.description: Relative or absolute path to the RGB image file

K.description: 3x3 Camera intrinsic calibration matrix [[fx, 0, cx], [0, fy, cy], [0, 0, 1]]

Rt.description: 4x4 Extrinsic matrix [R|t] in OpenCV convention (mapping world points to camera coordinate system: X_c = R * X_w + t)

depth_path.description: Optional path to the aligned depth map (e.g. 16-bit PNG or float32 npy/exr)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of capture or generation

source.description: Origin of the frame: 'capture' for multi-view photography, 'generated' for generative camera/diffusion

confidence.description: Optional pose/depth confidence score in range [0.0, 1.0]

metadata.description: Optional frame or scene metadata such as object dimensions, physical scale, or reference markers
